# Chatterly

> Chatterly is a chat application with direct messages, groups, voice and video calls and file sharing. Everything is end-to-end encrypted in the browser: the server cannot read messages or listen to calls. It is open source (ISC).

The application itself is private (it needs an account); only the pages below are public.

## Pages

- [Sign in](__SITE_URL__/login): unlock your encrypted vault with your username and password.
- [Create an account](__SITE_URL__/register): the keys are generated in your browser; the password never reaches the server.

## Project

- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/Jondals/Chatterly-Renewed#readme): features, how the security works and how to run your own server.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Jondals/Chatterly-Renewed/security/policy): how to report a vulnerability.
